questionEn: Coal and oil are fossils. Why are they called non-renewable?
questionUz: Ko'mir va neft qazilma hisoblanadi. Nima uchun ular qayta tiklanmaydigan deb ataladi?
choicesEn: It takes millions of years to form and is used up faster than it is replenished.
They can be grown in a year
choicesUz: Uning shakllanishi uchun millionlab yillar kerak bo'ladi va u to'ldirilganidan ko'ra tezroq sarflanadi.
Ular bir yil ichida o'stirilishi mumkin
